suites.name: BridgeBench published ratings

metric.name: comparative rating
metric.rangeBasis: display bounds of this captured rating snapshot; no accuracy normalization

suites.rights: Attributed factual ratings only; raw captures remain private. Proprietary methodology is not disclosed.
suites.reason: 27 captured model result pages; overall plus nine axes in native BridgeBench ratings.

currentPolicy.reason: Selectable publisher rating dataset. Protocol and uncertainty are unpublished; overall incorporates cost/speed. Excluded from independent capability scoring.

currentPolicy.rule: Current defaults require exact primary model identity, maintained exact benchmark and tested harness version, supported units, comparable conditions and a nonsaturated version. Historical factual admission and family caps remain separate.
currentPolicy.saturationRule: A source-declared saturated version, or a version qualified as saturated by a reviewed measured comparison, cannot enter current scoring. A high isolated score is not proof of saturation.
